description: A placeholder in a simple-CASE branch is typed against the operand, not hardcoded to bool -- simple CASE (CASE operand WHEN x THEN ...) compares a value, unlike searched CASE (CASE WHEN cond THEN ...) where the condition really is boolean

params.name: status
params.note: typed against the CASE operand's column (status, a string), not bool

name: param_in_simple_case
query_sql:
-- @name GetUserStatusLabel
-- @returns :many
SELECT CASE status WHEN $1 THEN 'match' ELSE 'other' END AS m FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL)
